title: Let’s Play Across Cultures: A Large Multilingual, Multicultural Benchmark for Assessing Language Models’ Understanding of Sports

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on CultSportQA, a curated dataset of text and image-based multiple-choice questions focusing on traditional and indigenous sports from diverse countries and continents to measure cultural knowledge and reasoning.

Benchmarking model performance across 11 different languages, including mid-to-low resource languages, using zero-shot, few-shot, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to identify accuracy disparities in non-English contexts.
